units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 65:16">Targ. Is. LXV, 16</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Jeremiah 16:17">Targ. Jer. XVI, 17</cite> (ed. Wil. <he>מִסַתְּרָן</he>, corr. acc.).

senses.gloss: to hide one’s self; to find shelter.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Ecclesiastes 7:12">Targ. Koh. VII, 12</cite>.—*<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Deuteronomy 29:5">Targ. Y. I Deut. XXIX, 5</cite> <he>מִסְתְּרָא וכ׳</he> finding shelter in your schools.—
<cite ref="Berakhot 31b:10">Ber. 31ᵇ</cite> <he>כיון דמִסְתַּתַּרְנָא</he> when I closet myself (with a stranger), v. <cite ref="O01711">preced.</cite>

<cite ref="Sotah 2b:23">Sot. 2ᵇ</cite> <he>זמנין דלא אִיסְתַּתְּרָא ואמר איסתתרא</he> (not <he>איסתתר</he>) it may happen that she did not closet herself with a man, but he (the husband) says that she did &c.
<cite ref="Sotah 2b:27">Ib.</cite> <he>ומִסְתַּתְּרָא וליכא וכ׳</he> Rashi (ed. <he>ומיסתתרה</he>) and she may closet herself, and we have in our days no waters … to test her &c.; a. e.
